reports.title: Guide
reports.query:
##### Audience
This report is intended for standards developers who define ActivityInstances.

This report allows for searching for SDTM information related to an ActivityIntanceClass and which codelist apply - or the other way around.

Domains marked with * are sponsor defined domains.

reports.title: SDTM information for $neodash_activityitemclassvalue_name
reports.query:
MATCH
  (dataset:Dataset)-[r:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (dataset_instance:DatasetInstance|SponsorModelDatasetInstance)-
    [r2:IMPLEMENTS_DATASET_CLASS]->
  (dataset_class_instance:DatasetClassInstance|SponsorModelDatasetInstance)
WHERE size(coalesce( $neodash_sdtm_domain, [])) = 0
   OR dataset.uid IN  $neodash_sdtm_domain
MATCH
  (dataset_class_instance)-[r3:HAS_PARENT_CLASS*0..]->
  (dataset_class_instance:DatasetClassInstance)-[r4:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (dataset_class:DatasetClass)<-[r5:MAPS_DATASET_CLASS]-
  (activity_instance_class:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (activity_instance_class_value)

MATCH
  (dataset_instance:DatasetInstance|SponsorModelDatasetInstance)-
    [hdv:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE]->
  (dataset_variable_instance:DatasetVariableInstance
    |SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance)<-
    [:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (dataset_variable:DatasetVariable)

// FROM DATASET VARIABLE INSTANCE TO ACTIVITY ITEM CLASS
MATCH
  (dataset_variable_instance)-
    [i:IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE|IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE_CLASS]->
  (variable_class_instance:VariableClassInstance)<-[d2:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (variable_class:VariableClass)<-[c:MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS]-
  (activity_item_class_root:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[r6:LATEST]->
  (activity_item_class_value:ActivityItemClassValue)

WHERE
  activity_item_class_value.name IN  $neodash_activity_item_class AND
  EXISTS((activity_item_class_root)--(activity_instance_class))

MATCH
  (activity_instance_class:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[k1:PARENT_CLASS]->
  (parentRoot:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)
MATCH (parentRoot)-[k2:LATEST]->(parentVal:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (activity_instance_class)-[k3:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]->
  (m)-[k4:LATEST]->
  (activity_item_class_value:ActivityItemClassValue)

// FROM DATASET VARIABLE INSTANCE TO CODELIST
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (dataset_variable_instance)-[:REFERENCES_CODELIST]->
  (aux_ctcr:CTCodelistRoot)-[aux_r:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (aux_ctatr:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[aux_r2:LATEST_FINAL]->
  (clattr:CTCodelistAttributesValue)

WITH DISTINCT
  activity_item_class_value.name AS `Activity Item Class`,
   CASE WHEN NOT (dataset)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->(:DatasetInstance) THEN dataset.uid+'*' ELSE dataset.uid END AS `SDTM Domain`,
  dataset_variable.uid AS `SDTM Variable`,
  hdv.ordinal as var_order,
  clattr.submission_value AS xmlcodelist
ORDER BY `Activity Item Class`,`SDTM Domain`, var_order
RETURN distinct `Activity Item Class`, `SDTM Domain`, `SDTM Variable`, xmlcodelist

reports.title: Select one (or more) Activity Item Classes - required
reports.query:
MATCH
  (activity_instance_class:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[r]->(activity_instance_class_value:ActivityInstanceClassValue) 
   WHERE (size(coalesce( $neodash_activity_instance_class, [])) = 0
   OR activity_instance_class_value.name IN  $neodash_activity_instance_class)
MATCH
  (activity_instance_class)-[k3:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]->
  (m)-[k4:LATEST]->
  (n:ActivityItemClassValue)
WHERE toLower(toString(n.`name`)) CONTAINS toLower($input) 
RETURN DISTINCT n.`name` as value,  n.`name` as display ORDER BY value ASC LIMIT 1000

reports.title: Filter on (or more) Instance Class - optional
reports.query:
MATCH (n:`ActivityInstanceClassValue`)<-[r]-(root:ActivityInstanceClassRoot) where not (root)<-[:PARENT_CLASS]-()
AND toLower(toString(n.`name`)) CONTAINS toLower($input)
RETURN DISTINCT n.`name` as value,  n.`name` as display ORDER BY value ASC LIMIT 100

reports.title: Possible domains
reports.query:
MATCH
  (dataset:Dataset)-[r:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (dataset_instance:DatasetInstance|SponsorModelDatasetInstance)-
    [r2:IMPLEMENTS_DATASET_CLASS]->
  (dataset_class_instance:DatasetClassInstance|SponsorModelDatasetInstance)
MATCH
  (dataset_class_instance)-[r3:HAS_PARENT_CLASS*0..]->
  (dataset_class_instance:DatasetClassInstance)-[r4:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (dataset_class:DatasetClass)<-[r5:MAPS_DATASET_CLASS]-
  (activity_instance_class:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (activity_instance_class_value)
MATCH
  (dataset_instance:DatasetInstance|SponsorModelDatasetInstance)-
    [hdv:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE]->
  (dataset_variable_instance:DatasetVariableInstance
    |SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance)<-
    [:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (dataset_variable:DatasetVariable)
MATCH
  (dataset_variable_instance)-
    [i:IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE|IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE_CLASS]->
  (variable_class_instance:VariableClassInstance)<-[d2:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (variable_class:VariableClass)<-[c:MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS]-
  (activity_item_class_root:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[r6:LATEST]->
  (activity_item_class_value:ActivityItemClassValue)
WHERE
  activity_item_class_value.name IN $neodash_activity_item_class AND
  EXISTS((activity_item_class_root)--(activity_instance_class))
WITH COLLECT(DISTINCT dataset.uid) AS domains
UNWIND domains AS domain
RETURN domain AS `SDTM Domains`, size(domains) AS `Total Domains`
ORDER BY `SDTM Domains`

reports.title: Codelists
reports.query:
WITH
  [x IN $neodash_sdtm_domain | replace(x, '*', '')] AS neodash_sdtm_domain_select_clean

MATCH
  (dataset:Dataset)-[r1:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (dataset_instance:DatasetInstance|SponsorModelDatasetInstance)-
    [r2:IMPLEMENTS_DATASET_CLASS]->
  (dataset_class_instance:DatasetClassInstance|SponsorModelDatasetInstance)
WHERE
  size(coalesce(neodash_sdtm_domain_select_clean, [])) = 0 OR
  dataset.uid IN neodash_sdtm_domain_select_clean
MATCH
  (dataset_class_instance)-[r3:HAS_PARENT_CLASS*0..]->
  (dataset_class_instance:DatasetClassInstance)-[r4:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (dataset_class:DatasetClass)<-[r5:MAPS_DATASET_CLASS]-
  (activity_instance_class:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)-[r6:LATEST]->
  (activity_instance_class_value)

MATCH
  (dataset_instance:DatasetInstance|SponsorModelDatasetInstance)-
    [hdv:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE]->
  (dataset_variable_instance:DatasetVariableInstance
    |SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance)<-
    [r7:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (dataset_variable:DatasetVariable)

// FROM DATASET VARIABLE INSTANCE TO ACTIVITY ITEM CLASS
MATCH
  (dataset_variable_instance)-
    [r8:IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE|IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE_CLASS]->
  (variable_class_instance:VariableClassInstance)<-[d2:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (variable_class:VariableClass)<-[c:MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS]-
  (activity_item_class_root:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[r9:LATEST]->
  (activity_item_class_value:ActivityItemClassValue)

WHERE
  activity_item_class_value.name IN  $neodash_activity_item_class AND
  EXISTS((activity_item_class_root)--(activity_instance_class))
WITH DISTINCT dataset_variable_instance
// FROM DATASET VARIABLE INSTANCE TO CODELIST
MATCH
  (dataset_variable_instance)-[m1:REFERENCES_CODELIST]->
  (cl:CTCodelistRoot)-[m2:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (cl_att_root:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[m3:LATEST_FINAL]->
  (cl_val:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
  
RETURN DISTINCT
  cl_val.concept_id AS `Codelist ID`,
  cl_val.submission_value AS `Codelist Submission Value`,
  cl_val.preferred_term AS `Codelist Preferred Term`

reports.title: Terms in selected codelist
reports.query:
MATCH (cl:CTCodelistRoot)-[m2:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (cl_att_root:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[m3:LATEST_FINAL]->
  (cl_val:CTCodelistAttributesValue) 
WHERE  cl_val.concept_id IN  $neodash_codelists_activity_item
MATCH
  (cl)-[m4:HAS_TERM]->
  (cl_term:CTCodelistTerm)-[m5:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->
  (term_root:CTTermRoot)-[m6:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (term_att_root:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[m7:LATEST]->
  (term_value)
RETURN DISTINCT
  cl_val.concept_id AS `Codelist ID`,
  cl_val.submission_value AS `Codelist Submission Value`,
  cl_val.preferred_term AS `Codelist Preferred Term`,
  term_value.concept_id AS `Term ID`,
  cl_term.submission_value AS `Term Submission Value`,
  term_value.preferred_term AS `Term Preferred Term`
